Question 15
?

Consider the straight line that passes through P(3,1,1) and is parallel to v=⟨−1,0,2⟩. Find all the possible points A on that line such that AP=5.

a
A1(2,1,3) and A2(1,2,−1)
b
A1(2,1,3) and A2(4,1,−1)
c
A1(1,2,3) and A2(4,1,−1)
d
A1(2,1,−2) and A2(4,1,1)
e
A1(2,1,3) and A2(2,−1,1)
Submit
